findings.title: The registered metric-alert handler is now abstract
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler requires counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data, but this subclass implements none of them. Detector.detector_handler unconditionally instantiates the registered handler, so a detector with type metric_alert_fire now raises TypeError and aborts process_detectors instead of returning the previous empty evaluation. Keep the stub concrete until these methods are implemented, or prevent the abstract handler from being instantiated.

findings.title: The dedupe test builds its expected occurrence for the wrong group
findings.body: The expected occurrence is built with group key "val1", but the subsequent evaluate_group_key_value call uses "group_key". build_mock_occurrence_and_event includes that key in the occurrence fingerprint, so the expected fingerprint is "<detector_id>:val1" while the actual fingerprint is "<detector_id>:group_key". The first result equality assertion therefore fails before the test reaches its duplicate-packet check. Build the expected occurrence with "group_key".
